beats_top.query: cornell grad student off-campus budget monthly rent Ithaca cheap neighborhoods
beats_top.why: The top results are rental listing pages and Cornell's generic off-campus aid page, with no single monthly grad budget set against the stipend. Our opening paragraph gives the range, stipend, and a line-by-line table with dated sources and nine-month caveats.
